Method.name: OnProcessInput
Method.Implementation: //Send a zip request to Business Operation set stFile=##class(%Stream.FileBinary).%New() Do stFile.LinkToFile(..DestFileName) set zipReq = ##class(HS.Message.ZipRequest).%New() set zipReq.File = stFile set zipReq.Operation = "FromZip" $$$TRACE("Ready to call unzip: " _ ..DestFileName) set pRequest = ##class(Ens.StringRequest).%New() Set tsc = ..SendRequestAsync(..TargetConfigNames,pRequest, .resp) quit tsc

Method.name: OnGetConnections
Method.Description: Return an array of connections for drawing lines on the config diagram
